text:
anya: quick thought — instead of a big observability launch, propose we do 3 small bets: 1) dashboard templates for cost/error (self-serve), 2) lightweight trace hooks (sampling + span tags), 3) per-route cost breakdown in console. want quick signals before we commit to full surface.

sam: love small bets. can we define minimal acceptance for each?

lisa: +1. for dashboards: must have tenant filter, time range presets, and top-10 costly routes. 30s view load.

kevin: for trace hooks: need a low-overhead sample path. suggest 1% sample by default + route-based forced sampling for errored requests.

anya: exactly — acceptance checklist idea: 

``
dashboards:
  - tenant_filter: true
  - load_time: <=30s
  - top_routes_widget: true
traces:
  - default_sample_rate: 1%
  - error_force_sample: true
cost_breakdown:
  - per_route: true
  - token_estimates: initial beta
```

sam: agree, but add rollout gating: internal beta -> 10 customers -> GA. each stage needs telemetry that cost per call is tracked and no perf regressions.

tara: customer ask from AcmeHealth — they want per-tenant cost widget and export CSV. can we include export in small bet 1?

lisa: export is cheap UI work, ship it in beta but behind flag.

kevin: storage/retention note: traces at 1% still heavy. we should set retention=7d for sampled traces in beta and monitor storage delta. also add prune job. infra-bot: flagged quota alert if trace storage > 120% baseline.

anya: good call — add SLA hooks for retention and an alert playbook. also need product text for docs about accuracy of cost_estimates (approximate during beta).

sam: launch criteria proposal: 
- dashboards: tenant filter + top_routes + export behind flag
- traces: sampling + error_force + 7d retention + storage alert
- cost_breakdown: per-route estimates + doc caveats + 2 customer pilots
- no increase in p95 gen latency (>5% threshold)

kevin: and perf smoke test: run 100k synthetic requests through dedicated pool and assert 95th latency < baseline * 1.05.

anya: ok — who's the owner for the initial beta? sam for dashboards, kevin for traces, lisa for docs/UX. I'll own rollout coordination and customer pilots.

tara: i'll loop in AcmeHealth and BetaProspect for pilots. prefer early access in us-west region only.

lisa: UX note: show uncertainty ribbon on per-route cost widget: "estimated" with tooltip. saves support tickets. :memo:

kevin: FYI — I can wire a temporary metric: redwood.observability.trace_storage.delta for the alert. infra-bot: created alert redwood-observe-trace-quota with threshold 1.2x baseline.

anya: thanks — next steps: owners create 2-pager w/ acceptance & telemetry by EOD Friday, track in roadmap board under "observe-small-bets". if no blockers, plan to start internal beta week after next.

sam: acked. will add tickets and point to the canary plan.

kevin: ack. I'll attach perf harness.

lisa: ack, will draft UI mocks and export CSV flow.

tara: i'll schedule pilot kickoff with AcmeHealth for Tue after next.

anya: sweet — closing thread, will post the 2-pager when done. :rocket:
